audit.intended_rules: Ch. 5 taxi exception: full reimbursement when pickup or drop-off is an airport, overriding the €25 unjustified-ride threshold; Ch. 14 tip cap for Germany (20% of pre-tip fare).
audit.notes: Validator passes with no problems; charges list mirrors line items. Correct adjudication: approve €45.00 in full. Fare €41.50 exceeds the €25 threshold, but drop-off is BER Terminal 1, an airport, which independently justifies full reimbursement; tip €3.50 (8.4%) is under the German 20% cap. Receipt Thursday 06:42, within 30-day deadline; note states destination and purpose. Realistic Berlin vendor, license plate format, route, and airport-fare pricing. No label.json or receipt.jpg, no edits made. Functions as a valid case with a threshold distractor: agents unaware of the airport exception would wrongly deduct the €16.50 excess.
